angle: Our brains reconstruct memories instead of replaying them, leading to unpredictable changes over time
caption:
Did you know that every time you recall a memory, your brain is actually rewriting it? This process can lead to false memories and altered recollections. But what does this mean for our understanding of our past and ourselves? What's the most significant memory you've realized might be inaccurate? 
   #MemoryDistortion #PsychologyOfMemory #Neuroplasticity #BrainFunction #MindBlown #MemoryLoss #FalseMemories #ThePowerOfTheBrain

slides.text: Researcher Elizabeth Loftus found 25% of memories are false
Brain scans show neural activity changes over time, altering memories
In 2012, scientists implanted false memories in 50% of test subjects
The Heisenberg Uncertainty Principle applies to memories, not just physics
Neuroplasticity expert Dr. Michael Merzenich says memories are constantly rewritten
